|stats = {{Name|Attack|+10%}} |value = 300 |gprice = 5000 }} The '''Ruby Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|5000}} after reaching level 80 in [[The Mines]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]] or dropped from [[Haunted Skull]]s. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es. The Ruby Ring increases [[Combat/Mechanics#Damage|damage]] dealt by weapon attacks by 10% while equipped. Equipping a second Ruby Ring increases the damage bonus to 20%. ==Dyeing== The Ruby Ring can be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==References== Ring::AddEquipmentEffects is called once for each equipped ring by BuffManager::GetValues. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Rubin-Ring]] [[es:Anillo de rubí]] [[fr:Bague de rubis]] [[it:Anello di rubino]] [[ja:ルビーの指輪]] [[ko:루비 반지]] [[hu:Rubin gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de rubi]] [[ru:Кольцо с рубином]] [[tr:Yakut Yüzük]] [[zh:红宝石戒指]]
